SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.

   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

13. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
